---
title: "My Quarto Shiny Document"
format: html
server: shiny
---
  
```{r}
#| panel: sidebar
helpText("This is a simple app in quarto.")
sliderInput("obs", "Number of observations:", min = 10, max = 500, value = 100)
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill
plotOutput("distPlot")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
  hist(rnorm(input$obs))
})
```
